observation: After workflow plan --supersede created an unapproved Contract revision 2 while a Run bound to revision 1 existed, agent-loop enter returned next_action_kind host_work to repair run.contract_revision_mismatch instead of decision_required approval of revision 2.

evidence.summary: enter after supersede: host_work run.contract_revision_mismatch; workflow approve revision 2 followed by enter prepared the Run, matching tests/Dogfood/AutonomousReplanDogfoodTest.php.

hypothesis: The Run disagreement outranks the missing approval when enter selects the next action.
validated_conclusion: An unapproved superseding Contract revision should route to its human approval decision; the revision mismatch resolves once that revision is approved and enter re-prepares the Run.
